blocks.text: Web design for small businesses in Eugene
Restaurants, trades, studios and shops. A few clear pages, hand-coded to load in under a second on any phone, with nothing bolted on to patch later.

steps.title: Tell me what you need
steps.description: A few sentences is enough. What the business does, what you want the site to do, and anything you already hate about the current one.

steps.title: You get a flat quote
steps.description: One price and a rough timeline, usually within a day. Nothing starts until you say yes to it.

steps.title: We build it in the open
steps.description: A real page goes up early and changes every few days. You watch it happen and say what you want different while it is still cheap to change.

steps.title: It goes live, and stays live
steps.description: I point the domain, set up hosting and SSL, and keep it running.

blocks.title: Domain, hosting, and updates, handled.
blocks.description: You don't have to learn what a DNS record is or pick a hosting company. I set all of it up and keep it running.
